'''June 2001 Marlton tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ on 3 June 2001. [[John Lolli]] won it. It is known from Greg Shaw's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2409">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ marlton-nj-06-03-01], DeckTech (Greg "TychoCelchu" Shaw, 4 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-04-marlton-nj-06-03-01d2409/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 3 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Great Traditions, Marlton, NJ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 16
* '''Winner:''' [[John Lolli]]
